_comment: Vetted fallback miners per PR Guard check, best first. Every check is first asked through Telegraph's routing (a canonical intent + params ask; see src/checks.js); a miner here is called directly only when the routed answer is unusable, and the next one only if that call fails. Entries: minerId, name, intent, method, endpoint, payload ({{var}} placeholders), normalizer (src/normalize.js), optional ecosystems filter, optional files filter (a regex any changed file must match), optional enabled:false. A routed answer from a miner listed here is read with its normalizer.

deps.name: PR Guard Sentinel
deps._note: Our own miner (disclosed); rates PyPI/Go/crates.io, which deps.dev Package Review (npm-only) can't.

deps.name: Secrev Depsdev
deps._note: Advisory ids only, unrated: last resort, so its findings give CAUTION, never BLOCK.

diff.name: CodeWire Smart Contract Audit
diff._note: Independent operator; a language-model audit of Solidity. Only for diffs that touch .sol files. Vetted Nov 13: found the reentrancy (critical) and open setOwner (high) in the demo vault, and only low issues in the fixed one.

diff.name: Telegraph Verity
diff._note: Independent operator. Takes the old intent name inside its payload (verified Nov 2 and Nov 13). Used for diff chunks over the 2,000-character canonical limit, or when the routed review is unusable.

diff.name: PR Guard Sentinel
diff._note: Our own rule-based miner (disclosed), used only if Verity fails.

addresses.name: GoPlus Security
addresses._note: Independent operator, proxying GoPlus. Token risk flags for an address (honeypot, owner powers, proxy, verified source). Vetted Nov 13 with USDT. Sourcify Verified Contracts (#200002) was tried for source verification, but its /contract endpoint passes every parameter through as a query string and Sourcify rejects them.

sanctions.name: Counterproof Sanctions Screener
sanctions._note: Independent operator (suggested by its builder on Nov 13). Screens an address against US OFAC, UN, EU and UK lists; exact match for wallet addresses. Vetted Nov 14: the Lazarus Group's Ronin wallet is BLOCK on the US list, USDT's contract is CLEAR. Routed canonical asks also reach it, but the node returns the match without the list name.
